Definition: of uncertain affinity; a prodigy or omen:--wonder.
BiblicalUsage: The word téras is the Bible's way of saying a wonder, a sign, a prodigy. In Matthew 24:24, shall shew great signs and wonders. Its 16 occurrences all press in the same direction.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe signs and wonders are never the point in themselves; they point to the God who does them. That is why I come back to téras whenever I need to remember what is true.
